selection.rule: Qualify each candidate at its own native reference pin; version migration to the product target is a separate required workstream. No candidate passes transfer across revisions.

official_linux_artifact.scope: Candidate 5.2 reference only; not the 5.4 product target.

independent_selected_suite_result.scope: Exact official native release, unchanged mathutils and BMesh source files, selected candidate-reference suites only.

source_reconstruction.warning: Numbered patches/series is development history and is not the canonical replay path. Follow the digest-bound canonical snapshot and verify application to the exact native reference.

independent_replay.scope: Exact official source checkout, patch byte verification, git apply --check and scratch application. No build or released artifact source correspondence established.

qualification_release.scope: Independent runtime probe of the released binary. Does not validate candidate HEAD, reproducible source build, native differential parity, hardware performance or the 5.4 product target.

observed_probe.scope: Two unchanged upstream Python suites at the 5.2 candidate reference. Not the product-target feature denominator.

upstream_suites.scope: Entire self-contained upstream unittest module, unchanged assertions; suite execution is required and skipped tests do not count as passing.
Entire self-contained upstream unittest module, unchanged assertions; suite execution is required and skipped tests do not count as passing.

known_gaps: Published README claims and strict milestone receipts differ; independent evidence is required.
EEVEE and several physics, media and interchange dependencies are unfinished or disabled in the published port.
Complete native test inventory, browser source build correspondence, two observed numeric test divergences and hardware validation remain qualification gates.
Published build configurations disable WITH_TESTS and WITH_GTESTS; separate test-enabled configurations are required.
